summary: Package entry point for the relational AST. Re-exports the fluent Relation API (relation, concat, GroupedRelation), from_arrow eager ingestion and the LogicalTerminalRequired error, and imports the backends package so Polars, Narwhals and Ibis relation systems register. Also holds two shared engines: AST-level schema inference (schema_inference.py) and compile-based schema resolution (schema_resolution.py).
key_classes: Relation — fluent plan builder (re-exported from core.relation_api)
key_functions: relation(data) — wrap a DataFrame/Python data/resource as a Relation
from_arrow(table, *, target=None) — eagerly import an Arrow table into an owned native source
infer_schema(node, ...) — AST-level output schema inference with per-field SchemaTypeStatus
resolve_schema(relation, ...) — structural-then-compiled schema evidence for a relation
assess_drift(...) — compare inferred schema to a contract (schema_inference.py)
